Add a 1px inner edge highlight #5C4A32 at 40% opacity on default panels so the inn frame reads as carved wood, not a flat fill.
character_identity: Class-color every roster name (mage #69CCF0, hunter #ABD473, and so on) and put a 16px class icon 6px left of the name.
Draw an 18px level coin on every card portrait, lower-left, 4px inset: fill #1A120C, ring #C4A574, numeral 11px #F3E6C4. Colonol Sunders currently has none.
Move the hero speech pill another 8px right so the tail clears the class badge by at least 8px.

Center the first-run 'Link account' control as a 140x26 bronze button under step 3; the small left ghost button looks unfinished.
elvui_wc3_fit: Skin secondary actions (Compact, View details, Link) as his blue enamel: fill #1E4C7A, top highlight #3D7AB5, 1px border #0E2438, cream label. Keep red #8C1E1E for Close and destructive only. The alert's flat brown button does not match Options.

alerts_ux: On the Esc strip, keep two lines: 'Cancel logout first.' at 13px #F3E6C4, then 'Hearth to Crossroads or reach an inn.' at 12px #C8B89A. Drop the trailing period. The hearth-only line loses the safety step.

Gear icon 14px #8A8070 inside a 28px hit target, 12px left of a 22px red close control.
readability: Row meta 'Lv 19 · Thunder Bluff · 3d ago' to 12px #D2C4AE (about 7:1 on #32261C). 11px #7A6E60 fails.
Pair 'none used this session' at 12px #B7AA96 with '0.6 rested levels left' at 13px #F0E2B6 on one baseline.

Hero kicker '#1 · PLAY NEXT' at 11px #E6C89A with slight tracking so it does not disappear above the name.
layout_polish: Lock chips in a 110px right column and end every rest bar 8px before that column. 'NEARLY FULL' currently pushes the bar.
Keep card state chips top-right of the portrait with an 8px gap from the level coin.
First-run steps as 44px rows, 16px icon column; 'No other account linked yet.' 12px #A89880, centered, 8px under the button.
Give the OUTSIDE chip 8px of left margin from the now-playing bar so they cannot collide.
delight: Speech pills max 280px wide, 13px #F7F0E0, 10px tail. Show zzz only on full or resting portraits.
Put the max-level aside on the row itself in 12px italic #C8B89A ('I keep the bench warm.'), not only as tiny right-side type.
Compact toast: 32px portrait, 8px padding, one speech line. Do not stack three lines that all say Full.

overall_notes: The roster job is solved: play-next, the four rest states, and the inn-versus-ElvUI split are clear and close to his real WC3 Gatewood windows. It is not a 9 yet. Dim row meta, brown alert buttons that are neither his blue enamel nor his red primary, a missing level coin on the unrested card, and a compact line that says Full twice are the gaps a demanding user would still mark.
